item.title: Setting up PowerDNS with Recursor and PowerAdmin on FreeBSD 15
item.description: article pre { border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 35px 58px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 0px -12px 30px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 0px 4px 6px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.17) 0px 12px 13px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09) 0px -3px 5px; } A while ago I took on the challenge of deploying a brand new DNS server setup on FreeBSD. The requirements of the project demanded a little bit more than what BIND or Unbound could provide, so I settled on PowerDNS coupled with the PowerAdmin web frontend.
